candidates.description: This feature vector represents abstract mental constructs and theoretical ideas.
This vector represents indefinite pronouns and interrogative words concerning objects, people, and concepts.
This feature activates on conjunctive, transitional, and causal adverbial connectors that link clauses and indicate logical relationships.
This vector represents inherent or fundamental qualities, often relating to underlying nature or inevitability.
This vector activates for terms and roots associated with philosophy, psychology, and theoretical or intellectual disciplines.
This vector represents the concepts of comparison, difference, and logical consistency between multiple entities or ideas.
This feature vector represents the concept of being, existing, or occurring.
This feature vector represents the concept of vital importance and necessity.
This vector represents common grammatical punctuation marks, particularly em dashes and en dashes, often attached to function words or used as clause separators.
This feature activates for verbs and nouns related to communication, inquiry, and speech acts.
